title: What Did I Do All Day?

collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — INNER LIFE, PART VIII (141-160, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)
the owner's naming rule (2026-11-15): a person the draft names by role is a cast villager, named at the first mention

collection.description: At the end of the day, a villager feels they got nothing done at all, and a friend asks how the day was.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: At the end of the day, (subject) sits down and has the uncomfortable feeling that (subject.he/she) got nothing done. Nothing at all. The day just disappeared. (friend) sits down beside (subject.him/her) and asks how (subject.his/her) day was. "I don't know," says (subject). "I didn't do anything."

choices.label: Let It Be a Quiet Day

a.name: Answer A
a.text: "What did you do this morning?" asks (friend). Well, (subject) fetched water. Then helped carry some baskets. Then showed a child how to tie a knot. Then fixed a bit of thatch. Then cooked. Then helped look for a missing sandal. Then... (subject) stops. "Oh," (subject.he/she) says. It was a lot of little things. It just didn't feel like anything while (subject.he/she) was doing it.

b__fx.name: Answer B
b__fx.text: "That's alright," says (friend). "Some days are like that." (subject) isn't completely convinced. But (subject.he/she) eats dinner, and watches the fire, and talks a bit, and goes to bed, and in the morning (subject.he/she) finds (pupil), a child, proudly tying the knot (subject.he/she) taught yesterday. (subject) had forgotten all about that.
